Pick the correct colour mapping for a grouping variable

lookup_colour.Rd

Internal helper used by plotting functions to select the right fixed colour mapping (species, gear, etc.) based on the column being coloured.

Usage

lookup_colour(var_name)

Arguments

var_name

Character string giving the name of the grouping column.

Value

A named character vector of colours, or NULL if no fixed mapping exists for var_name (falls back to ggplot's default).
